title: Sum Until Zero
description: Read whole numbers, one per line, until the number `0` is entered (the `0` is not counted). Print the sum of the numbers entered.
hints: Read once before the loop, then read again at the end of each round.
solution_code:
total = 0
n = int(input())
while n != 0:
    total += n
    n = int(input())
print(total)
